Motor Accident Claims Tribunal (MACT), Srinagar in a claim petition on File No. 52/2015 titled "Shahid Shafi and Ors. Vs. Farooq Ahmad Najar and Ors." came to pass an award thereby granting an amount of Rs. 28, 52,644/- along with interest @ 7.5% per annum from the date of filing of the claim petition till actual realization.

sentences.text: 2. In the claim petition, the claimant No. 1-Shahid Shafi, the claimant No. 2- Suhail Shafi, the claimant No. 3- Rubina & the claimant No. 4- Rozia Shafi, are the sons and daughters of the deceased Mohammad Shafi Malik who lost his life in the road traffic accident.

3. Claimants No. 2 to 4 at the time of institution of the claim petition were minors and were Shahid Shafi & Ors vs Farooq Ahmad Najar And Ors on 3 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/22907854/
1 represented through their uncle, Mohammad Maqbool Malik, who figured as claimant No. 5.
4.

sentences.text: In terms of the award dated 29.06.2021, the claimants No. 2 to 4 were actually awarded the entire compensation amount of Rs. 28, 52,644/- as claimant No. 1- Mohd Shafi and claimant No. 5- Mohamamd Maqbool Malik were held to be not entitled to any compensation on account of being serving in the Government Departments and having their separate income.
5. The compensation awarded was meant to be equally shared amongst the three claimants i.e., 2 to 4 along with the entire consortium payment amount.

6. Out of the awarded amount of Rs. 28, 52,644/-, 25% of each share of the three claimants was to be released immediately in their favour and the balance amount was to be kept in the fixed deposit account till the age of their majority, with liberty to withdraw the interest on a monthly basis.

7. Against this award, all the five claimants came forward with an appeal MA No. 49/2021 under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 before this Court, which came to be disposed of in terms of judgment dated 27.12.2024 by this Court.

8. In fact, in terms of the judgment dated 27.12.2024, another connected appeal i.e., Mac Appeal No.
48/2021 was also disposed of thereby making it to be a common judgment.

9. In terms of the judgment dated 27.12.2024, insofar as related to Mac Appeal No 49/2021 is concerned, this Court came to enhance the compensation of Rs. 28, 52,644/- to Rs. 33, 34,960/-
with further modification that even the claimant No. 1-Shahid Shafi was also held entitled to the compensation but only restricted to an amount of Rs. 4.00 lacs, whereas the rest of the entire awarded, compensation enhanced from Rs. 28, 52,644/- to RS. 33,34,960/- was to be shared equally by the claimants No. 2 to 4 who were appellants No. 2 to 4 before this Court.

10. It is now for seeking withdrawal of the deposited compensation amount lying with this Court that applicants No. 1 to 4, have come forward, in which claimant No. 4/applicant No. 4-Rozia Shafi (daughter) is still minor, whereas claimants No. 1 to 3 are all majors by their age as reflected in the application, and are seeking release of the deposited compensation amount in their favour.

11. The original award dated 29.06.2021 passed by the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal (MACT),
Srinagar for an amount of Rs. 28, 52,644/- was meant only for claimants No. 2 to 4 to the exclusion of the claimant No. 1, whereas in terms of the judgment dated 27.12.2024 passed in Mac Appeal No.
49/2021, appellant No. 1/claimant No. 1 has been held entitled to receive only Rs. 4.00 lacs, with rest of the compensation amount to be paid entirety in equal shares in favour of the three claimants i.e., appellants No. 2 to 4.
12.

The claimants No. 2 and 3 are claiming to be now majors, though there is no proof of the age of claimants No. 2 and 3 for confirming the fact that they have attained the age of majority so as to be eligible to receive the compensation payable in their favour in entirety without getting in fixed deposit mode as originally directed by the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal (MACT), Srinagar.

sentences.text:
Therefore, this Court directs the learned counsel for the applicants to come forward with the age proof of the applicants No. 1 to 4 in the form of school certificates, for enabling this Court to pass definite order as to how the release of the compensation amount in favour of the claimants No. 2 to 4 shall take place i.e., in the manner as directed by the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal (MACT),
Srinagar or directly in their favour without any fixed deposit reference.
14. List this application for disposal on 15.09.2025.
(RAHUL BHARTI) JUDGE SRINAGAR:
